title: "Network diagram"
description: "A node-link diagram from an igraph graph, laid out with a stress layout."
categories: [Networks]
---



`vgraph()` starts a plot from an igraph graph and computes a layout (stress by
default). `mark_edges()` and `mark_nodes()` then draw the graph, with node
attributes mapped to size and fill.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
g <- igraph::make_graph("Zachary")
g <- igraph::set_vertex_attr(
  g, "grp",
  value = as.factor(igraph::cluster_louvain(g)$membership)
)
g <- igraph::set_vertex_attr(g, "deg", value = igraph::degree(g))

p <- vgraph(g, layout = "stress") |>
  mark_edges(alpha = 0.4) |>
  mark_nodes(size = deg, fill = grp) |>
  scale_size(range = c(2, 8)) |>
  labs(title = "Zachary's karate club", fill = "community")
```
